lines.trans: Samy, come see for a minute.
Yes, Mr. Barneville, I am coming.
Do you still want to do cinema?
Yes, it is my great dream!
Do you want to audition?
An audition? Are you serious?
It is for my film A cran.
Do you have a resume and photos?
I have everything in my bag.
Bring them right away.

words.gloss: continuation; tout de suite = right away

lines.trans: You are making my dream come true today!
Careful, these are just screen tests.
If you succeed, the role is yours.
Thank you, I will give my best!

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: J'ai apporté cinq exemplaires des contrats.
examples.trans: I've brought five copies of the contracts.

meanings.note: je viens d'arriver = I've just arrived

examples.text: Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: as an interjection: bon, alors... = right, so...

meanings.en: bonne journée = have a nice day

examples.text: Elle me veut pour le casting!
examples.trans: She wants me for the casting!

meanings.en: casting, audition process (for a film or play)

meanings.note: before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.trans: Shall we go to the cinema?

meanings.en: notch, courage; à cran = on edge

meanings.note: written CV, pronounced as two letters
dans une heure = in an hour

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.

meanings.en: to give a hand (donner un coup de main)

examples.text: Akerfelt n'a pas aimé son essai.
Aux essais, il parlait, il parlait!
examples.trans: At the screen tests, he talked and talked!

meanings.note: pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

examples.trans: I just want to see Mathias.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà
merci beaucoup = thank you very much

examples.text: Monsieur Audibert nous reçoit dans cinq minutes.
examples.trans: Mr Audibert will see us in five minutes.

meanings.note: before a name: Monsieur Kerr; written M.

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.
Tu réalises ce que tu as fait?
examples.trans: Do you realise what you did?

meanings.en: to carry out, to direct (a film)

meanings.note: réussir à faire qc = to succeed in doing sth

examples.text: C'est notre seule chance de réussir!
examples.trans: It is our only chance to succeed!

meanings.en: part, role (in a film or play)

examples.text: Pose ton sac sur la table.
examples.trans: Put your bag on the table.

examples.text: Si tu veux le rôle, tu dois changer.
examples.trans: If you want the part, you have to change.

meanings.en: tu es sérieux?: are you serious?

meanings.note: used alone, after a preposition, or for emphasis: et toi?, avec toi, toi aussi
informal, one owner; ton, ta, tes

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone
singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age
venir de: je viens de la Côte d'Azur
venir de + infinitive: je viens d'arriver = I've just arrived
+ noun: je veux un café; + infinitive: je veux partir
je vous rappelle = I'll call you back
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
